executive_summary: A dedicated search for New York Fashion Week Spring/Summer 2028 developments this window -- the point in the annual calendar where the season's opening week would be expected per docs/EDITORIAL_CALENDAR.md -- turned up no CFDA-issued preliminary or official schedule, no dated designer lineup, and no show coverage. This mirrors the 2027-09-06 window's finding for Paris (FHCM had confirmed SS28 dates while New York had not); one week later, New York's SS28 calendar remains unannounced. No other current, well-corroborated style/garment/aesthetic discourse surfaced beyond items already logged in prior reports.

top_signals.name: New York SS28 schedule still unannounced
top_signals.evidence: Checked cfda.com's fashion-calendar and news pages, plus WWD and Business of Fashion's fashion-week coverage, for a CFDA-issued New York Spring/Summer 2028 preliminary schedule. All available dated schedule coverage from these outlets is for the Spring/Summer 2027 cycle (the Sept 2026 season); nothing for SS28 has been published as of this window. This is a continuation of the same gap flagged for New York in the 2027-09-06 report (signal_id pfw-ss28-calendar-confirmed), where Paris's FHCM had already confirmed its SS28 dates.
top_signals.index_note: Logged as a logistics/calendar gap, not a style signal -- no garment, silhouette, or aesthetic claim is being made here.
top_signals.human_editor_note: Confidence is held manually at 'low' rather than letting derive_confidence() read three sources across two sectors as 'high': this is an absence-of-evidence claim (no schedule found), not a corroborated positive report, and a negative claim from a handful of outlet checks does not warrant the same confidence tier as three sources independently confirming the same positive fact. It is also possible a schedule exists but wasn't surfaced by this search pass -- flagged here rather than treated as confirmed non-existence. Distinct signal_id from last week's pfw-ss28-calendar-confirmed since this is about New York specifically, not a restatement of Paris's already-confirmed dates.

limitations: No genuine, current NYFW SS28 schedule, designer lineup, or show coverage was found this window; New York's fashion-week authorities have not yet published SS28 dates.

This report cannot distinguish 'New York has not announced SS28 dates yet' from 'an announcement exists but wasn't surfaced by this search pass' -- treated as the former per available evidence, flagged as uncertain in the signal's human_editor_note.
thin_week_note: Only one genuinely checkable, current item surfaced this window (New York's SS28 schedule remaining unannounced), and it is a calendar/logistics fact, not a style signal. Report reflects limited coverage rather than manufacturing a trend claim to fill the usual signal quota.
